tokens.name: surface-canvas
tokens.usage: Page background for every reading surface. Warm paper white, never pure white — keeps long sessions from feeling clinical.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, modals, the comparison panel, popovers — anything that sits above canvas.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Secondary surfaces set back from reading: side navigation, the Structural Reading panel ground, inactive tab wells.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals and bottom sheets (reading-mode picker, book/chapter picker).

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Background for the selected row in a picker list (book, chapter, translation, view mode).

tokens.name: ink-primary
tokens.usage: Bible text and primary reading content. The highest-priority color in the system — reserved for what the user came to read.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting UI text: breadcrumb, labels, chapter headings, translation names, verse numbers at rest.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Muted metadata: timestamps, placeholder text, disabled control labels, footnote markers.

tokens.name: ink-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a filled accent-greek-700 or accent-hebrew-700 surface (primary buttons, active pill).

tokens.name: ink-on-accent-tint
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a light accent tint (accent-greek-100/hebrew-100), e.g. the selected row in a picker.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Default 1px dividers: between verses' hit areas, list rows, the top-bar underline, table-of-contents rules.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, the segmented control's outer edge, structural-node card borders — anything that must read as a boundary, not a hint.

tokens.name: accent-greek-050
tokens.usage: Faintest Greek/Product wash — hover background for nav rows in the Greek (current) product.

tokens.name: accent-greek-100
tokens.usage: Selected-state fill: active nav item, selected translation row, active tab underline background.

tokens.name: accent-greek-300
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: progress indicators, decorative rules on Brand/About surfaces, chart-adjacent uses. Not for body text (fails contrast on paper).

tokens.name: accent-greek-600
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state for accent-greek-700 controls, and for icon-only accents at rest (e.g. the active reading-mode icon).

tokens.name: accent-greek-700
tokens.usage: The Product Accent for 聖書［緑版］ — Greek Bible identity. Primary buttons, the active segmented-control pill, selected navigation state, key interactive elements. Meets 4.5:1 on surface-canvas and surface-raised; use ink-on-accent for text on top of it.

tokens.name: accent-hebrew-050
tokens.usage: Reserved for 聖書［赤版］ (future Hebrew product). Faintest Hebrew/Product wash — parallel role to accent-greek-050. Not used in the current Greek-only build.

tokens.name: accent-hebrew-100
tokens.usage: Reserved for 聖書［赤版］. Selected-state fill, parallel role to accent-greek-100.

tokens.name: accent-hebrew-300
tokens.usage: Reserved for 聖書［赤版］. Secondary accent, parallel role to accent-greek-300.

tokens.name: accent-hebrew-600
tokens.usage: Reserved for 聖書［赤版］. Hover/pressed state, parallel role to accent-greek-600.

tokens.name: accent-hebrew-700
tokens.usage: Reserved Product Accent for 聖書［赤版］ (Hebrew Bible identity), same structural role as accent-greek-700, for when the product family ships Hebrew. Meets 4.5:1 on surface-canvas with ink-on-accent. Do not use in the current Greek product.

tokens.name: structural-function-fill
tokens.usage: Structural Reading: FUNCTION layer fill (subject / verb / object / complement boxes) in the Reed–Kellogg-style diagram. Warm yellow-green (H≈103°) to distinguish from CONSTRUCTION and MORPHOLOGY fills.

tokens.name: structural-function-ink
tokens.usage: Structural Reading: label text on FUNCTION boxes (.hdg-fn chips). Meets 6.2:1 on structural-function-fill and 7.2:1 on surface-canvas. Olive-green direction (H≈107°), distinct from accent-greek-700 and structural-morphology-ink.

tokens.name: structural-construction-fill
tokens.usage: Structural Reading: CONSTRUCTION layer fill (.hdg-clause--sub backgrounds, apposition / coordination / clause groupings). Cool teal-green (H≈155°), more saturated than MORPHOLOGY fill to remain distinguishable.

tokens.name: structural-construction-ink
tokens.usage: Structural Reading: label text on CONSTRUCTION boxes (.hdg-clause-label). Meets 6.1:1 on structural-construction-fill and 7.7:1 on surface-canvas. Teal-forest green (H≈152°), distinct from accent-greek-700.

tokens.name: structural-morphology-fill
tokens.usage: Structural Reading and word-order mode: MORPHOLOGY layer fill (case, tense, mood tags on a word chip).

tokens.name: structural-morphology-ink
tokens.usage: Structural Reading: label text on MORPHOLOGY chips. Meets 6.1:1 on structural-morphology-fill. Deliberately a different lightness from structural-function-ink, structural-construction-ink, and accent-greek-700 so all three layers and the product accent stay distinguishable without relying on hue alone.

tokens.name: structural-connector
tokens.usage: Tree lines and brackets joining structural nodes. Never carries meaning alone — always paired with the connected boxes' own layer color.

tokens.name: signal-attention-fill
tokens.usage: Sparse, non-alarming notices only: a translation gap, a textual variant note, a beta/roadmap label. Never for errors framed as urgent — this is a reading app, not an operational dashboard.

tokens.name: signal-attention-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on signal-attention-fill. Meets 4.5:1.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard-focus outline, offset 2px from the element, on every focusable control. Deliberately ink, not a hue, so focus is never confused with product accent, selection or structural meaning.

families.reading-ja: "Yu Mincho", "YuMincho", "Hiragino Mincho ProN", "Noto Serif JP", serif

styles.name: ui-caption
styles.usage: Verse numbers, timestamps, structural role tags in the tab bar.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Breadcrumb segments, bottom-navigation labels, form field labels.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.usage: Menu rows, picker list items, panel body copy, button labels.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Panel and sheet titles ("読み方を選ぶ"), section headings inside Research surfaces.

styles.name: ui-display
styles.usage: Chapter heading in the reading surface itself (e.g. "ローマ人への手紙 第1章"), used sparingly.

styles.name: verse-ja
styles.usage: Primary Bible text in Single reading state, Japanese translations. Generous 2x line-height for long, unbroken sessions.

styles.name: verse-ja-comparison
styles.usage: Bible text inside a Comparison pane (desktop side-by-side or mobile stacked) — one step smaller and denser than single reading so two translations both stay comfortably readable.

styles.name: verse-ja-compact
styles.usage: Bible text used as reference/context only, e.g. the collapsed preview of a chapter in the book/chapter picker.

styles.name: verse-source
styles.usage: Greek New Testament / LXX running text when read as the primary text (Default view on the Greek text) or as interlinear source above a translation. Reserved family: also carries future Hebrew.

styles.name: word-source-inline
styles.usage: Individual Greek word tokens inside WORD_ORDER and STRUCTURE modes, and inside word-level research popovers.

styles.name: gloss-source
styles.usage: Small interlinear gloss under a source word (lemma, gloss) in WORD_ORDER mode.

styles.name: structural-tag
styles.usage: FUNCTION / CONSTRUCTION / MORPHOLOGY role labels on a structural node ("主語", "同格", "前置詞句"). Set with letter-spacing in CSS, not in this token.

styles.name: structural-node-text
styles.usage: The Bible words shown inside a structural node box — same reading-source or reading-ja family is layered on top via class composition; this style sets the box's default UI metrics.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag internal padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps: verse number to verse text, structural tag to its box edge.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Clause-level gap inside a structural breakdown; gap between a word and its interlinear gloss.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and card internal padding; minimum vertical gap between consecutive verses in dense/compact contexts.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Default vertical rhythm between verses in Single reading — the primary reading cadence.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Paragraph-break spacing within a chapter; gap between the chapter heading and verse 1.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Translation-to-translation gap in stacked Mobile Comparison; gap between the reading surface and a footer/meta block.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Chapter-level top spacing on Desktop; separation between the Reading Surface and a fully different context (e.g. Research deep-dive header).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Structural-node boxes, small tags and chips (MORPHOLOGY, CONSTRUCTION labels).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, input fields, the book/chapter picker rows, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets and panels that rise from the edge of the screen: the mobile reading-mode sheet, the Research side panel on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Segmented control track and thumb (単一表示 / 比較表示), translation chips.

tokens.name: border-width-hairline
tokens.usage: Default rule weight — list dividers, top-bar underline, structural-node borders.

tokens.name: border-width-strong
tokens.usage: Input and segmented-control outer edges; anything that must read as a container, not a hint.

tokens.name: border-width-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard-focus outline width, paired with color focus-ring.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Floating, non-modal surfaces that sit above the reading pane: the Research side panel, hover popovers, the desktop comparison-setup panel.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets rising from the edge of the mobile viewport (reading-mode picker, book/chapter picker).
